justification: 22 files changed (test infrastructure + docs). No production logic modified. Tests and hooks only — cannot produce wrong user-facing data. Standard because >3 files and structural change to CI gate.

pre_impl.existing_data: No production data interaction. Test files only assert against component output. Pre-push hook adds a Jest step.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If jest.config.js path is wrong, pre-push hook fails and blocks push — fail-safe direction.

functions.name: FixedJsdomEnvironment
functions.output: jsdom global with Node 20+ Web API globals restored
functions.if_none: Falls back to standard jsdom behaviour — Response/fetch undefined errors in tests

values.if_missing: Global not restored, test using that global fails with ReferenceError

break_it.scenario: jest-environment-jsdom npm package not installed in node_modules
break_it.what_happens: Jest fails to start — 'Cannot find module jest-environment-jsdom'
break_it.how: Already in package.json devDependencies and node_modules present. Pre-push hook failure blocks push — fail-safe.

break_it.scenario: Pre-push hook Jest step fails on CI where node_modules not installed
break_it.what_happens: Push blocked with clear error message directing to run npx jest --verbose
break_it.how: .githooks/pre-push:26 — checks for jest.config.js existence, skips with WARNING if missing
break_it.repro: Move jest.config.js temporarily and run git push

break_it.scenario: Test assertions reference old UI text that component has since changed again
break_it.what_happens: Jest test fails, pre-push blocks push — fail-safe. Developer must update test.
break_it.how: This is the intended behaviour — tests catch UI drift. Failing test = signal to update assertions.
break_it.repro: Change button text in a component without updating its test file

post_merge.manual_verify: Run git push on a branch to verify the 4-check pre-push hook works end-to-end
